newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Chuan Soon Huat soars 70 pct at debut.
newsitem.headline: Chuan Soon Huat soars 70 pct at debut.

text.p: Shares in joinery products distributor Chuan Soon Huat Industrial Group Ltd soared 70 percent from their initial public offer (IPO) price of Singapore $0.35 to a high of S$0.595 on their first morning of trading on Wednesday.
More than 15 million shares in the company changed hands in the first 10 minutes of trading. The price settled down later to around S$0.56.
Chuan Soon Huat said on Tuesday its 46.125 million public IPO shares had been 51.68 times subscribed.
The company makes and distributes doors, conservatories and other joinery products.
